description: All twenty affected readings completed the 390px Study/light row inspection and sampled navigation pass. Representative narrow enlarged-text, desktop, Punjabi and Hindi layouts and a keyboard scenario also passed. Physical iPhone/Safari and VoiceOver speech checks remain outstanding.

scope.countingNote: The 698 inspected targets are unique within the twenty affected readings. The 564 supplemental row inspections repeat targets in seven representative configurations; the 111 harness jumps are sampled checks across configurations, not 111 distinct anchors. The keyboard scenario is counted separately.

configuration.scope: Baseline twenty-reading pass only; supplemental configurations are recorded in representativeMatrix.

provenance.rawEvidenceCoverage: One completed Sukhmani batch: 30 jumps at preorder indices 3–32, plus collapsed/expanded row and disclosure checks.
provenance.transcriptSummaryCoverage: The earlier 3-target Sukhmani batch and nine completed three-target reading cases were observed in successful tool responses. Their summaries are recovered from the conversation transcript; their full raw results were not persisted before the tool store reset.
provenance.reconstructedFields: Reading names and row counts agree with the reviewed manifest. Per-target geometry, focus records, disclosure records and timings are not reconstructed where the raw result was lost.
provenance.historicalEvidence: 2026-11-01 audit artifacts are unchanged and are not used as proof that the new expandable Contents passed live.
provenance.additionalRawEvidenceCoverage: Ten newly completed reading cases retain full raw output: 354 Contents rows and thirty representative jumps.
provenance.representativeRawEvidenceCoverage: Seven completed cases retain full raw results: 564 repeated Contents-row inspections and 21 sampled jumps across narrow, desktop, Punjabi and Hindi configurations.

observedChecks.caveat: The first 33 Sukhmani jump checks preceded the explicit current-row-visibility assertion. A separate observed close/reopen check put Ashtpadi 1 in view; assertions for all initial 33 jumps are not inferred. The later narrow and Punjabi Sukhmani cases each passed this assertion on three samples, including Ashtpadi 24 stanza 8.
laterNineteenCases: Current marker visible within the reopened Contents viewport

interruptedRunsExcluded.description: Longer Sukhmani runs interrupted by a Vite module reload or Runtime.callFunctionOn timeout; no completed-result credit.

remainingChecks: VoiceOver speech on the physical device
supplementalVisualObservations: Sukhmani expanded Contents was visually reviewed at 390px light mode.
Raag Maala Contents was visually reviewed at 320px in dark Read mode with root font 32px and Gurmukhi text 34px.
Ramkali was visually reviewed at 1280px in light Study mode with focused Stanza 2.
Punjabi Sukhmani at 390px showed clear expanded Ashtpadi 1 and stanza 1–8 labels alongside Gurmukhi excerpts.
Hindi Ramkali at 390px showed clear expanded Sadd stanza 1–6 labels alongside literal Gurmukhi headings and excerpts.
limitation: No reader issue was found in the completed coverage. The pass does not certify every target in every layout or physical-device behavior; interrupted or stale-build runs receive no pass credit.

codeVerification.note: No runtime implementation changes followed the recorded code verification; no code issue was found in the live coverage. This checkpoint does not rerun those tests.

representativeMatrixNotes.textEnlargement: The narrow cases use a 320×740 CSS viewport, root font 32px (twice the 16px baseline) and separately selected 34px Gurmukhi text. This is a text-enlargement simulation, not browser zoom, uniform 200% text scaling, iOS Dynamic Type or a physical-device test.
representativeMatrixNotes.localizedChecks: Punjabi Sukhmani and Hindi Ramkali check representative localized UI function and layout. English label equality is disabled; exact Gurmukhi excerpts, literal-label language tags, geometry and navigation remain checked. Visual review is not linguistic expert certification.
representativeMatrixNotes.coverage: All twenty affected readings have baseline row inspection. Supplemental layouts and locales are representative cases, not a full cross-product or exhaustive click-through.

actualKeys: Tab through Close, search, parent link and disclosure
Space collapses the group without moving the reader or changing progress/saved places
Tab to stanza 2 and Enter jumps to verse 21631
Escape closes Contents and restores focus to its opener
keyboardScenario.entryPointFocus: The Contents trigger and Return button were focused programmatically. Navigation within Contents used actual keyboard events; this is not claimed as an exclusively keyboard-driven path from an arbitrary page location.
keyboardScenario.savedPlaceTimestampNote: Return refreshed updatedAt, so the raw serialized placesUnchanged value is false. Saved reading coordinates remained unchanged.

historicalSupplementalVisualObservations: Ardaas reader and Contents were observed in an earlier fallback browser's desktop dark mode. That fallback observation is not counted as proof of the final current-build desktop matrix.
visualEvidenceProvenance: Screenshots were displayed and reviewed in browser-tool responses; the screenshot files were not persisted. These are qualitative visual observations, separate from the stored numeric harness results.
